excluded_payload_scan_scope: Excluded subtrees were not recursively statted or content-read. Concrete SNAP payload exclusions are the manifest-listed source files only, not an exhaustive size inventory of all local data.
existing_tracked_artifacts_policy: Keep existing tracked v3 IO/pilot/prebuffer/verification notes and metadata; this list is an allowlist for new artifacts, not a deletion plan.

secret_scan.scope: Only core/recovery config/*.json, including machine/execution/catalog; no raw coordinate payloads, source snapshots or private esa content were scanned.
secret_scan.limitations: Pattern scan detects explicit serial/UUID/token/credential forms; not a guarantee against all secrets. Absolute local user paths remain in provenance, but were not classified as authentication secrets.

finalization_required: Publication section URL mapping and esa screenshot are recorded after publication.
